Esta es una herramienta versátil para cualquier persona que utilice metal. La he utilizado para construir armaduras, doblar barras de refuerzo y hacer piezas metálicas decorativas para soldar. Me gusta el mango largo, que da mucha palanca para doblar fácilmente el metal. Esta herramienta ahorra tiempo en la producción y puede doblar muchos tipos de metal.

Foarte util, foarte robust, foarte bun preț. Spirala are o mică ezitare la curba de racordare între partea mică și cea mare. A trebuit să ajustez acea parte. La versatilitate nu stă foarte bine, fiindcă se schimbă mai greoi accesoriile între prelucrarea în unghiuri și cea în spirală. Dar fiind o sculă de tip hobby, pot trece cu vederea. Pe ansamblu este un utilaj bun.

Se pueden cerrar con llave, pero, aun así, si alguien quisiera robarlos, podría desmontarlos a mano y quitarlos del techo en cuestión de minutos. Caben 2 tablas + 2 pares de esquís encima de ellas o 4 pares de esquís. Como puntos negativos: sin esquís se mueven un poco. Además, tuve que poner un fieltro para proteger los raíles. Podrían incluir una goma en la pieza que se utiliza para fijarlos.

These Ski racks are a great value. These racks are secure and fairly sturdy. When latched a close there does feel a bit of wiggle and play, but it’s not the end if the world. I use these for my long fishing poles and I’ve driven over miles with them loaded up and had no concern of these unlocking. They feel like they securely lock. The finish doens’t feel as premium as other rack systems I used, but for the price I feel like the are unmatched. These are perfect to throw on and then remove. Very practical and worth the asking price. Don’t hesitate to buy.

Feels like a product that can only be used so many times, understandably so; the harsh conditions in which they’re used can turn the bolts rusty very quickly, however, it did its job with two boards and without any issues, waiting to use them on a second winter.

Seems to be good quality so far, would buy again. Be aware that the top rubber is shorter than the bottom rubber, meaning there is room for one less ski. This goes for both racks. Not shown on the pictures before you buy. I would have loved to have a quick clamp system for faster mounting onto the car's roof rack, but I can't really complain at this price point.
